metasystem goal · the backlog: open, approve, budget, claim and conclude goals

Read
  list                   list the open goals
  show                   one goal's record: intent, next step, budget and designs
  notes                  read, add or close a goal's non-breaking read findings

Decide
  open                   declare a new goal
  approve                approve goals for execution
  unapprove              withdraw a goal's execution approval
  budget                 read a goal's budget, or give it a box
  prioritize             place an open goal in priority 1, 2 or 3
  pin                    pin a goal to one machine, or clear its pin
  allow                  allow a goal something it may not do by default
  disallow               withdraw something a goal was allowed
  accept-risk            accept the risk of one severe or unproven review finding
  review                 record your verdict on a goal waiting to land
  land-without-sitting   let a goal that waits for your review land without a sitting

Work
  claim                  claim a goal for this session, or the next ready goal
  release                release a claim this session holds
  pause                  park a goal with a reason
  resume                 resume a parked goal, or a stopped goal under its standing box
  done                   conclude a goal
  reopen                 return a done or abandoned goal to the queue with a fresh next step
  abandon                record that a goal will never be worked, and why

Shape
  edit                   change a goal's intent, next step, risk or labels in place
  split                  split a goal into independently claimable related goals
  group                  put a goal into a group of related goals
  ungroup                take a goal out of its group of related goals
  block                  record that a goal waits for another
  unblock                remove one blocker from a goal
  sync                   bring the goal files and the published ledger into agreement

→ metasystem goal ACTION --help  one action's forms, options and examples
